task:
FIX FOUR REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #802 (sequential ECR Public pulls). Target branch codex/run-38040971079-1, expected head 0ba501b; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py, tests/test_review_lab_v3.py, .github/workflows/container-image-parity.yml and tests/test_container_image_parity.py may change.

F1 (P1, parity workflow ~line 196): the 'Built image parity' pre-pull warms only the digest-qualified API base and the web bases, but `docker compose build api eddn importer` also needs the TAG-ONLY reference public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-slim used by apps/eddn/Dockerfile and apps/importer/Dockerfile (a digest pull does not warm a tag reference), and compose builds in parallel by default. FIX: build the image list from every distinct `FROM` reference across apps/api/Dockerfile, apps/eddn/Dockerfile, apps/importer/Dockerfile and apps/web/Dockerfile (dedupe, keep order), pull them sequentially with the retry helper and a 2 s gap, AND run the compose build in the parity test with `--parallel 1`? — no: do not change the test's build command; instead ALSO pass `COMPOSE_PARALLEL_LIMIT=1` as an env var on that workflow step (document in a comment that it serialises compose builds so base pulls are never concurrent). Update tests/test_container_image_parity.py to assert eddn/importer Dockerfiles are in the grep list and COMPOSE_PARALLEL_LIMIT: '1' is set on the parity step.

F2 (P2, lifecycle.py ~line 251): run_subprocess raises a timeout ReviewLabError (without failure_code) when a pull exceeds TIMEOUTS.image_pull, so the retry loop exits on attempt 1. FIX: in _pull_with_retry catch ReviewLabError from run_subprocess whose cause is a timeout (check `isinstance(exc.__cause__, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)` or the message starting 'Command timed out'), treat it as a failed attempt (record 'timeout' as the last output), sleep and retry; after the final attempt raise the classified REVIEW_STACK_START_FAILED error with safe_diagnostics {'service', 'attempts', 'last_error': 'timeout'}. Test: run_subprocess stub raises the timeout error twice then succeeds -> attempts == 3.

F3 (P2, workflow ~line 66): each shell `docker pull` is unbounded, so a stall consumes the whole job instead of retrying. FIX: wrap each pull as `timeout --signal=TERM 300 docker pull --quiet "${image}"` in both workflow pre-pull steps; assert 'timeout --signal=TERM 300 docker pull' in the workflow test.

F4 (P2, lifecycle.py ~line 299): no delay between the Redis pull and the API base pull. FIX: sleep TIMEOUTS.image_pull_backoff_seconds before the API base pull as well (i.e. between every consecutive pull); update the ordering test to assert the sleeps.

VALIDATION: 1. python -m pytest tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_review_lab_timeouts.py tests/test_container_image_parity.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  2. ruff check scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py  3. yaml.safe_load of the parity workflow  4. git diff --name-only 0ba501b lists only the four allowed files. Commit message: 'ci: pre-pull every Dockerfile base, serialise compose builds, bound and retry stalled pulls'.
